race.comment: SATIN SERENADE (11) was savagely backed fresh on the back of some strong hype around her but found one better. There's still high hopes held for this filly, so should be taking care of these. CHINTA (2) is a daughter of So You Think on debut for the Ryan & Alexiou yard Fitter for three trials and a betting watch is advised. SOURSEANE (6) only warmed into it late on debut at Kembla and while she's drawn to get back again, she could cause a late scare if the pace is genuine. FARCOLO (9) is another that can figure but really all eyes are going to be on the favourite who should take care of these on the way back to something stronger.
